contentText: FRANCE 24 Washington Correspondent Fraser Jackson reviews US President Donald Trump’s first year back in the White House. The year began with the creation of DOGE, the Department of Government Efficiency, which oversaw mass layoffs across federal agencies. Trump also expanded ICE and ordered large-scale deportations. On the international front, he helped achieve a ceasefire in Gaza and continued to push for an end to the war in Ukraine. Meanwhile, Trump launched an audacious military raid on Venezuela aimed at capturing President Nicolás Maduro and, weeks later, threatened to seize Greenland.
